title: Graph allows skipping screen and still running index; today's CLI forbids that combination
detail: buildGraph(def,h,{skip:['screen']}) is accepted and runGraph runs index after a skipped screen. packages/meeting-bot/src/capture/record-commands.ts:90 throws '--index requires --process-video', and record-finalize.ts:246-262 runs index only after process-video succeeds. WEBINAR_PIPELINE marks screen optional:true, so the planner and the graph disagree with the real sequencing. Not a defect while unwired; must be decided (Approver) before wiring.
fix_direction: Before wiring, either record the intended behaviour in DECISIONS (index may run without screen) or make screen non-optional in WEBINAR_PIPELINE.
reproduction: read record-commands.ts:90 vs pipeline-graph.test.ts first test (skip screen -> complete)

title: At-least-once handler execution (crash after side effect, before succeed) is not stated in the module header
detail: Resume re-runs the interrupted node (test 'resume after a crash mid-graph' proves it, cause lease-expired). Header of pipeline-graph.ts and graph-types.ts only imply idempotency via outputFingerprint; nothing says handlers must tolerate re-execution, nor that a superseded lease mid-node leaves the side effect done but unrecorded.

title: No test for multi-dep skip or skipping an optional stage with its optional dependent
detail: Mutants first-dep-only, last-dep-only and drop-continue survive the pipeline-graph suite. Equivalent on current WEBINAR_PIPELINE (single-dep, index non-optional) but at-most-one-dep is not enforced by the validator.
fix_direction: file-dont-fix; add tests if a multi-dep or optional-chain definition is introduced.
